title: Diffusable Latents from Structure-Agnostic Distillation
title_zh: 来自结构无关蒸馏的可扩散潜变量

paragraphs.en: Principles of Generative Modeling (PriGM) @ NeurIPS 2026
paragraphs.zh: 生成式建模原理（PriGM）@ NeurIPS 2026

paragraphs.en: Distilling pretrained foundation models into an autoencoder bottleneck improves latent diffusability, enabling diffusion models to converge faster and reach higher sample quality. Standard distillation aligns the latent at each position to a co-located teacher feature, tying the latent layout to the teacher’s. We show this constraint is unnecessary: aligning a single pooled image-level descriptor to the teacher’s performs as well as or slightly better than dense position-wise distillation. We compare first-order and relational pooled objectives across latent shapes and teacher modalities. First-order matching extends naturally to 1D token-sequence latents and across modalities, where distilling a text encoder into an image autoencoder still improves diffusability; a relational objective based only on each image’s nearest neighbours improves it as well. Code and blog post are available at github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation and kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation .
paragraphs.zh: 将预训练基础模型蒸馏到自编码器的瓶颈层中，可以提升潜在空间的扩散能力，使扩散模型能够更快收敛并达到更高的样本质量。 标准蒸馏方法会将每个位置的潜在空间特征对齐到同一位置的教师模型特征上，从而将潜在空间的布局与教师模型的布局绑定在一起。 我们证明这种约束并非必要：只需将单个池化后的图像级描述符对齐到教师模型的特征，其效果就与密集的位置级蒸馏相当，甚至略胜一筹。 我们在不同的潜在空间形状和教师模型模态上，比较了一阶目标和关系型池化目标的表现。 一阶匹配方法可以自然地扩展到一维令牌序列的潜在空间以及跨模态场景；在这种情况下，将文本编码器蒸馏到图像自编码器中仍然能够提升扩散能力，而仅基于每幅图像最近邻的关系型目标同样也能实现这一效果。 相关代码和博客文章可在 github.com/AdrienRR/structure-agnostic-distillation 和 kyutai.org/blog/2026-09-28-structure-agnostic-distillation 获取。

paragraphs.en: Latent diffusion trains a diffusion prior in an autoencoder’s latent ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , and sample quality depends on how diffusable that latent is ( Skorokhodov et al., 2025 ) . Prior work makes the latent more diffusable by distilling a frozen pretrained vision encoder into the autoencoder bottleneck, matching each latent position to its co-located patch feature ( Peng et al., 2022 ; Hu et al., 2023 ; Russell et al., 2025 ; Yao and Wang, 2025 ; Bi et al., 2026 ) . A more extreme line replaces the trained encoder with a frozen representation model and diffuses in its output space ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Tong et al., 2026 ; Singh et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Guo et al., 2026 ) . Both approaches place the latent and the teacher on a shared patch grid. But such a grid can be unavailable: compact 1D token latents, a short list of tokens with no spatial layout ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Bachmann et al., 2025 ) , drop it on the student side for efficiency, and a teacher from another modality, such as a text encoder, never had one to share. Position-wise distillation then reaches these settings only through an artificial correspondence, as SoftVQ-VAE ( Chen et al., 2025 ) does by replicating latent tokens and learning a projector to a pretrained grid. We ask whether distillation can improve diffusability without any token-level correspondence between the latent and the teacher.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在扩散模型在自编码器的潜在空间中训练扩散先验（Rombach 等人，2022；Peebles 和 Xie，2023），而样本质量取决于该潜在空间的可扩散性（Skorokhodov 等人，2025）。 早期研究通过将冻结的预训练视觉编码器蒸馏到自编码器的瓶颈中，使潜在空间更具可扩散性，并将每个潜在位置与其同位置的局部特征相匹配（Peng 等人，2022；Hu 等人，2023；Russell 等人，2025；Yao 和 Wang，2025；Bi 等人，2026）。 一种更极端的方案是用冻结的表示模型替换训练好的编码器，并在其输出空间中进行扩散（Zheng 等人，2025；Tong 等人，2026；Singh 等人，2026；Hu 等人，2026；Guo 等人，2026）。 这两种方法都将潜在空间和教师模型置于共享的局部特征网格上。 但这样的网格可能并不存在：为了效率，紧凑的一维令牌潜在空间（仅包含没有空间布局的少量令牌）（Yu 等人，2024；Bachmann 等人，2025）在学生模型侧省略了该网格，而来自其他模态的教师模型（例如文本编码器）则从未拥有过可共享的网格。 因此，基于位置蒸馏的方法只能通过人为对应关系来实现这些设置，正如 SoftVQ-VAE（Chen 等人，2025）通过复制潜在令牌并学习一个投影器到预训练网格中所做的那样。 我们想知道，在潜在空间和教师模型之间没有任何令牌级对应关系的情况下，蒸馏是否仍能提升可扩散性。

paragraphs.en: We study structure-agnostic distillation : we pool each image’s latent tokens into one image-level descriptor and define the distillation objective on these descriptors alone, leaving the latent’s internal layout free (Figure 1 ). Because pooling reduces each image to a single vector, the objective is independent of the latent’s token count and layout, so student and teacher may take any shape. We compare a family of pooled objectives: a first-order match that aligns each descriptor directly to its teacher descriptor, and relational objectives ( Park et al., 2019 ; Passalis and Tefas, 2018 ; Tung and Mori, 2019 ; Tian et al., 2020 ) that instead match the matrix of between-image similarities, via centered kernel alignment ( CKA , Kornblith et al. 2019 ) or a softmaxed-similarity KL divergence ( Soft-KL ); both are detailed in Section 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了与结构无关的蒸馏方法：我们将每张图像的潜在标记池化为一个图像级描述符，并仅基于这些描述符定义蒸馏目标，从而保持潜在表示的内部布局自由（图1）。 由于池化操作将每张图像简化为单个向量，因此该目标与潜在表示的标记数量及布局无关，这意味着学生和教师模型可以采用任意结构。 我们比较了一系列基于池化的目标函数：一种直接对齐每个描述符与其教师描述符的一阶匹配方法，以及关系性目标函数（Park et al., 2019; Passalis and Tefas, 2018; Tung and Mori, 2019; Tian et al., 2020），后者通过中心化核对齐（CKA, Kornblith et al. 2019）或经过softmax处理的相似性KL散度（Soft-KL）来匹配图像间相似性矩阵；这两种方法均在第2节中进行了详细说明。

paragraphs.en: To our knowledge, this is the first study to show that aligning pooled representations can replace position-wise alignment while improving diffusability. Varying only the distillation loss at fixed architecture and budget, first-order pooled matching performs as well as or slightly better than position-wise alignment where the latter applies, and structure-agnostic distillation extends to shapes that position-wise alignment reaches only through an artificial correspondence, handling a 1D token-sequence latent and letting a text encoder improve the diffusability of an image latent. Representation distillation can transfer useful semantic geometry into a generative latent without inheriting the teacher’s structural organization.

paragraphs.en: For image i i in a batch of B B , each structure-agnostic objective mean-pools the student’s N s N_{s} latent tokens z i ∈ ℝ N s × d s z_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{s}\times d_{s}} (resp. the teacher’s N t N_{t} features g i ∈ ℝ N t × d t g_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{t}\times d_{t}} ) into one L 2 L_{2} -normalized descriptor u ^ i ∈ ℝ d s \hat{u}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{s}} (resp. v ^ i ∈ ℝ d t \hat{v}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{t}} ; the two dimensions generally differ). Pooling discards the token layout, so the same objective works whatever the latent’s shape. They relax the correspondence position-wise distillation requires: position-wise ties each latent token to its co-located teacher token ( z i , j ↔ g i , j z_{i,j}\!\leftrightarrow\!g_{i,j} ); a first-order pooled match ties one descriptor per image ( u ^ i ↔ v ^ i \hat{u}_{i}\leftrightarrow\hat{v}_{i} ); a relational match ties none, matching only the between-image similarity matrices ( S s ↔ S t S_{s}\leftrightarrow S_{t} , with S s , i ​ j = u ^ i ⊤ ​ u ^ j S_{s,ij}=\hat{u}_{i}^{\top}\hat{u}_{j} and S t , i ​ j = v ^ i ⊤ ​ v ^ j S_{t,ij}=\hat{v}_{i}^{\top}\hat{v}_{j} ). We instantiate three: one first-order and two relational.

sents.zh: 池化操作会丢弃标记的布局信息，因此无论潜在表示的形状如何，该目标都能正常工作。

sents.en: They relax the correspondence position-wise distillation requires: position-wise ties each latent token to its co-located teacher token ( z i , j ↔ g i , j z_{i,j}\!\leftrightarrow\!g_{i,j} ); a first-order pooled match ties one descriptor per image ( u ^ i ↔ v ^ i \hat{u}_{i}\leftrightarrow\hat{v}_{i} ); a relational match ties none, matching only the between-image similarity matrices ( S s ↔ S t S_{s}\leftrightarrow S_{t} , with S s , i ​ j = u ^ i ⊤ ​ u ^ j S_{s,ij}=\hat{u}_{i}^{\top}\hat{u}_{j} and S t , i ​ j = v ^ i ⊤ ​ v ^ j S_{t,ij}=\hat{v}_{i}^{\top}\hat{v}_{j} ).
sents.zh: 它们放宽了位置级蒸馏所要求的位置对应关系：位置级匹配将每个潜在标记与其位于相同位置的教师标记绑定（ z i , j ↔ g i , j ）；一阶池化匹配则将每幅图像的一个描述符绑定（ u ^ i ↔ v ^ i ）；关系匹配则不绑定任何具体标记，仅匹配图像间的相似性矩阵（ S s ↔ S t ，其中 S s , i ​ j = u ^ i ⊤ ​ u ^ j 且 S t , i ​ j = v ^ i ⊤ ​ v ^ j ）。

sents.en: We instantiate three: one first-order and two relational.
sents.zh: 我们实现了三种方法：一种一阶匹配和两种关系匹配。

Each arm trains the autoencoder on 256 × 256 256{\times}256 ImageNet ( Deng et al., 2009 ) from scratch (50 epochs, batch 256), then a LightningDiT-XL prior (64 epochs, batch 1024). paragraphs.en: We compare our structure-agnostic methods against two references: a control with no distillation ( No Distillation ), and the position-wise baseline, VA-VAE’s ( Yao and Wang, 2025 ) vision-foundation alignment ( VF ), which aligns each latent cell to its co-located teacher feature. paragraphs.en: We hypothesise that pooling helps in-modality by averaging out distractors carried in the teacher’s per-token features. Positional information is one such distractor: self-supervised ViTs encode substantial positional signal in their tokens ( Amir et al., 2021 ) , and position-wise alignment copies it into the latent, where it competes with the content the decoder must reconstruct; pooling averages it out. High-norm artifact tokens ( Darcet et al., 2024 ) are another such distractor. A latent PCA (Appendix B.2 ) is consistent with this picture: the position-wise VA-VAE latent inherits a smooth spatial gradient artefact that the pooled latents lack.
paragraphs.zh: 我们假设，池化通过在教师模型每个词元的特征中平均掉干扰项，有助于模态内处理。 位置信息就是其中一种干扰项：自监督 ViT 在其词元中编码了大量位置信号（Amir et al., 2021），而位置对齐会将这种信号复制到潜在空间中，使其与解码器需要重建的内容相互竞争；池化则能将其平均掉。 高范数的人工词元（Darcet et al., 2024）是另一种类似的干扰项。 潜在空间中的 PCA（附录 B.2）与此观点一致：位置维度的 VA-VAE 潜在变量继承了一种平滑的空间梯度人工产物，而这种产物在池化后的潜在变量中并不存在。

paragraphs.en: With a text teacher, Pool-Align brings gFID from 9.52 to 6.97, close to its 5.77 with DINOv2, and Soft-KL also improves it, so both help in every setting. Only CKA fails across modalities; we hypothesise that its constraint, the full centered between-image geometry, is the strictest of the three. Our captions largely restate each image’s ImageNet class, so part of the gain may be class-level semantics. We test one text encoder and caption source, and not text-to-image generation, where a conditioning-aligned teacher could help more.
paragraphs.zh: 使用文本教师模型后，Pool-Align 将 gFID 从 9.52 降低至 6.97，接近其使用 DINOv2 时的 5.77；Soft-KL 也带来了改进，因此两种方法在所有设置中都有帮助。 只有 CKA 在所有模态中都表现不佳；我们推测，其约束条件——完整的中心化图像间几何结构——是三者中最严格的。 我们的图像说明大多只是重述了每张图像的 ImageNet 类别，因此部分性能提升可能源于类别层面的语义信息。 我们仅测试了一种文本编码器和一种图像说明来源，而未测试文本到图像生成场景，而在那种场景中，条件对齐的教师模型或许能带来更大的帮助。

paragraphs.en: We show that latent distillation can improve diffusability without requiring spatial correspondence. Pooling representations performs as well as or slightly better than position-wise alignment for image teachers, and extends distillation to 1D latents and to a text teacher, where Pool-Align and Soft-KL improve generation quality. paragraphs.en: We build on VA-VAE [ Yao and Wang, 2025 ] . The 2D-grid tokenizer is its convolutional VAE: input 256 × 256 256\times 256 , base width 128 128 , channel multipliers ( 1 , 1 , 2 , 2 , 4 ) (1,1,2,2,4) (four 2 × 2\times downsamples, an f ​ 16 f16 reduction), two residual blocks per stage, self-attention at 16 × 16 16\times 16 , and a 32 32 -channel latent, giving a 32 × 16 × 16 32\times 16\times 16 posterior. The 1D-sequence tokenizer keeps this convolutional encoder and decoder unchanged and replaces only the bottleneck by a Perceiver-style resampler [ Jaegle et al., 2021 ] : K = 32 K=32 learned latents of dimension 128 128 cross-attend to the 16 × 16 16\times 16 conv tokens ( 2 2 attention blocks, 8 8 heads) to form the token sequence, and 256 256 learned position queries cross-attend back for decoding.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的工作基于 VA-VAE [ Yao 和 Wang，2025 ]。 其卷积 VAE 采用二维网格分词器：输入为 256 × 256，基础宽度为 128，通道乘数（1, 1, 2, 2, 4）（四次 2 × 2 的下采样，f16 降维），每阶段包含两个残差块，在 16 × 16 处使用自注意力机制，并生成一个 32 通道潜在变量，从而得到 32 × 16 × 16 的后验分布。 一维序列分词器保持该卷积编码器和解码器不变，仅将瓶颈部分替换为 Perceiver 风格的重新采样器 [ Jaegle 等人，2021 ]：K = 32 个维度为 128 的可学习潜在变量与 16 × 16 的卷积令牌进行交叉注意力（2 个注意力块，8 个头），以形成令牌序列；同时，256 个可学习的位置查询则反向进行交叉注意力以实现解码。

paragraphs.en: ℒ vae \mathcal{L}_{\text{vae}} is the standard VA-VAE tokenizer objective, unchanged by our distillation term. It combines an L 1 L_{1} pixel reconstruction and a VGG-LPIPS perceptual loss [ Zhang et al., 2018 ] , wrapped in a learned-variance negative log-likelihood; a KL term pulling the posterior toward a standard normal, weighted by 10 − 6 10^{-6} : at this weight it is not a generative prior but a light regularizer that keeps the latent’s scale and posterior variance bounded, so the latent handed to the diffusion prior stays smooth and well-conditioned; and a hinge adversarial loss from a PatchGAN discriminator [ Isola et al., 2017 ] , enabled after 5000 5000 steps and weighted by 0.5 0.5 times an adaptive factor. The adaptive factor is the ratio of the reconstruction and adversarial gradient norms at the decoder’s last layer, the standard VA-VAE balancing.
paragraphs.zh: ℒ vae \mathcal{L}_{\text{vae}} 是标准的 VA-VAE 分词器目标函数，不受我们蒸馏项的影响。 它结合了 L 1 L_{1} 像素重建和 VGG-LPIPS 感知损失 [ Zhang et al., 2018 ]，并封装在具有学习方差的负对数似然中；一个将后验分布拉向标准正态分布的 KL 项，权重为 10 − 6 10^{-6}：在此权重下，它并非生成性先验，而是一个轻微的正则化项，用于限制潜在变量的尺度和后验方差，从而确保传递给扩散先验的潜在变量保持平滑且条件良好；此外还有一个来自 PatchGAN 判别器 [ Isola et al., 2017 ] 的铰链对抗损失，该损失在 5000 步后启用，权重为 0.5 乘以自适应因子。 自适应因子是解码器最后一层中重建梯度范数与对抗性梯度范数的比率，即标准的 VA-VAE 平衡机制。
